description: Write a PySpark ETL script for retail_chain that rolls store-level daily metrics up to region level. The script should: (1) left-join store metrics to the store-to-region mapping, assigning 'UNASSIGNED' to stores without a mapping, after reducing the mapping to one current row per store, (2) aggregate per region: revenue, transactions and visitors, (3) compute avg_basket = revenue / transactions and conversion_rate = transactions / visitors from the regional sums, rounded to 2 and 4 decimals, (4) return null conversion_rate for a region when any of its stores has unknown visitors, rather than a rate over partial data. In the sample, rows are tagged with _dataset = store_metrics or store_region_map.
edge_cases: West avg_basket is 1090 / 103 = 10.58; averaging the store-level baskets (10.00 and 30.00) gives 20.00
s1 has a historical mapping to North; joining without filtering is_current counts s1's revenue in two regions
s4 has no mapping and must be kept under 'UNASSIGNED' (left join)
s3 has unknown visitors: East's conversion_rate is null, not 50 / 0 and not computed from a zero-filled visitor count
Regions with zero transactions must yield null avg_basket rather than a division error
common_failure_modes: FM3: Average of ratios used instead of ratio of sums
FM1: Non-unique mapping fans out store rows and double counts revenue
FM1: Inner join drops stores without a region mapping
